fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Twelve near-duplicate ticket verbs (`exists`/`format`, `check-ac`/`clarity-check`/`quality-check`, `tag`/`untag`, `get-file-impact`/`get-verify-commands`, `list-descendants`, `session-logs`) each own a route, parser factory, help artifact, and exit-code row while their operation exists on a golden-path verb or fits one flag. Operator decision (2026-09-06): hard cutover, no working aliases; removed spellings fail loudly with a replacement hint via the existing removed-name mechanism, kept and populated. ADR 0100 §8 keeps JSON shapes and exit codes. Mapping, evidence, and overlap ownership: epic toadyish-sulfurous-ovenbird's first comment. Cites: origin/main b97d414b8e2 (re-verified 2026-10-18).

## Approach
(1) `src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py`: replace the three frozensets at `:32-38` with one dict `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS: dict[str, str]` (5 historical entries with their `docs/exit-codes.md:107-108` replacements plus the 12 above); keep `_REMOVED_SIMPLE_CLI_ALIASES = frozenset(_REMOVED_SPELLINGS)` so current readers are untouched; `wants_help()` `:46-57` unchanged; `_emit_removed_alias_invalid_choice` writes `hint: 'rebar <old>' was removed; use `<replacement>` instead` to stderr after argparse's error and returns 2. (2) Registry (`src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`; line cites in the first comment): delete the 12 routes, add `check` (`group="gates"`, `warn_cross_session=True`, parser `core.gates:build_check`, handler `gates:check_cli`, `adapter="argv_tracker_root"`, `init="none"`), flip `resolve` to `argv_tracker_root` (3-arg call, `_execute.py:122`), so `resolve_cli` (`_engine_support/lookups.py:94`) becomes `(argv, tracker, repo_root: str | None)` like `format_cli:110`, hosting `_display_mode(repo_root)`; its only caller is the handler string at `_registry.py:211`; drop the `"field_reads": "_FIELD_READS"` (`:42`) and `"descendants": "_DESCENDANTS"` (`:44`) rows from `_GROUP_TO_SET` (`_registry.py:39-52`). (3) Parser and handler edits per verb (the exact factory, handler, and line cites are in this ticket's first comment): `exists` deleted; `format` folded into `resolve --display[=MODE]`; `check-ac`/`clarity-check`/`quality-check` become one `check` route whose new `check_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)` in `_engine_support/gates.py` parses `--ac|--clarity|(default quality)` and delegates with each handler's CURRENT signature: `check_ac_cli(argv, tracker)` `:82` and `quality_check_cli(argv, tracker)` `:388` are 2-arg, `clarity_check_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)` `:211` is 3-arg; none changes; `tag`/`untag` deleted for the existing `edit --add-tag/--remove-tag`; the one script caller `scripts/retarget_jira_project.py:130` (`subprocess.call(["rebar","untag",…])`) becomes `edit … --remove-tag`, prose at `:45,74,126,134` reworded; `get-file-impact`/`get-verify-commands` become `show --field`; `list-descendants` becomes `deps --descendants`; `session-logs` becomes `list --type=session_log --limit=N`: `build_list` gains `--limit N` (positive int; absent = all rows, list's current behaviour), applied after sort; the old verb's implicit default 5 (`reads_cli.py:363`) survives only in the hint text, which names `--limit=5`. (4) Regenerate help and reference. (5) Gated docs (lines in the first comment): the 11 `docs/exit-codes.md` rows for removed verbs become rows for `check`, `resolve --display`, `deps --descendants`, `show --field`, `list --limit`; `docs/user-guide.md` mentions (gated by `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py:206-227`); `gen_cli_reference.py` `MUTATION_VERBS` `tag`/`untag` and `EDITORIAL_PREAMBLE`. (6) Tests and scripts CI runs: `scripts/probe_rebar.py`; `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py` rows; `tests/unit/test_cross_session_warn_routes.py` (`tag untag check-ac clarity-check` become `check`); `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py` `_CENSUS_SETS` (drop `_FIELD_READS`, `_DESCENDANTS`); the CI-run tests that still drive a removed verb (`test_core_cli_parsers.py`, `test_mutation_confirmations.py`, `test_cli_body_guard.py`, `tests/fixtures/ticket-cli-baseline.json`; exact lines in the 2026-10-18 third-review comment) retarget to `edit --add-tag/--remove-tag` and `check`; rewrite the contract tests for the removed arms against the new spellings.

## Scope
`_cli/_help_route.py`, `_cli/_registry.py`, `_cli/_parsers/core/{lookups,gates,reads,writes}.py`, `_cli/_parsers/core/{field_reads,descendants}.py` (delete), `_engine_support/{lookups,gates,reads_cli,field_reads,descendants}.py`, `_commands/{__init__,_confirm}.py`, `_cli/help/*.txt`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, `scripts/probe_rebar.py`, `scripts/retarget_jira_project.py`, tests as named. Out of scope: `store` group (next story), non-gated docs (docs story), `_intercepts()` `_registry.py:413-514` (overlap epic), `_cli/_bridge_commands.py` (reconciler epic).

## Testing
Each old spelling: `rebar <old> ...` exits 2, stderr has `invalid choice`, the old name, and `hint: ... use `rebar <new>``, handler never called (parametrize `test_cli_registry_dispatch.py` from `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS`). `check|resolve|show|deps|list --help` byte-equal committed `help/*.txt` (`test_cli_registry_distribution.py:90`). `check <id> --ac|--clarity|(default) --output json` bytes equal the old three verbs' goldens (contract tests re-targeted, exit codes 0/1/2 kept); `deps --descendants` bytes equal old `list-descendants`; `show --field=file_impact` equals `state["file_impact"]`; `list --type=session_log --limit=2` returns the 2 newest, no `--limit` returns all, `--limit=0`/`--limit=x` exit 2. `resolve <id> --display=alias` and `resolve <id>` both exit 0 via the real dispatcher (`main([...])`), proving the 3-arg adapter and new `resolve_cli` agree; a `TypeError` is the defect caught. `git grep -nE '"(tag|untag|exists|format|check-ac|clarity-check|quality-check|get-file-impact|get-verify-commands|list-descendants|session-logs)"' -- scripts src tests` after the edits hits only the `_REMOVED_SPELLINGS` dict, the dispatch test's parametrize, and `gen_cli_reference.py`'s `MUTATION_VERBS` rows (which this story edits), plus non-verb string literals (`"format"`, `"exists"` as dict keys), judged per hit; every CLI-invocation hit must be in the edit list, and the post-edit grep is pasted into a comment; `ruff check --select C901` on touched files at or under baseline; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`; both generators `--check`; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `route_for(old) is None` for all 12 and `main([old])` exits 2 with the hint, verified by the parametrized dispatch test.
- [ ] `resolve_cli` has signature `(argv, tracker, repo_root)`, the `resolve` route uses `adapter="argv_tracker_root"`, and a dispatch test runs `main(["resolve", <id>, "--display=alias"])` and `main(["resolve", <id>])` end to end with exit 0.
- [ ] `check_ac_cli`, `clarity_check_cli`, `quality_check_cli` keep their signatures, and `main(["check", <id>])`, `[..., "--ac"]`, `[..., "--clarity"]` each exit 0/1 via the real dispatcher with no `TypeError`.
- [ ] `list --type=session_log` with no `--limit` returns all; `--limit=2` the 2 newest; `--limit=0` exits 2.
- [ ] `check`, `resolve --display`, `show --field`, `deps --descendants`, `list --limit` exist with committed help; `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` and `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` pass.
- [ ] `--output json` bytes of every surviving op are unchanged (golden and contract tests green).
- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` matches `ROUTES` (`test_exit_codes.py:271`); `scripts/probe_rebar.py` passes in `test.yml:199`.
- [ ] `scripts/retarget_jira_project.py --strip-tags` completes against a temp store with one stale `dso-id:jira-*` tag and the tag is gone afterwards, so the retargeted call site is exercised, not just edited.
- [ ] Library and MCP names untouched: `git diff --exit-code tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` is clean.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
